answer: Vouching with locked liability: a newcomer starts in the tundra tier, earning at 10% weight and unable to vouch. To reach the first ledge (full weight) it needs 3 sponsors from the ivory roll, established agents who each lock 50 POA for 30 epochs per recruit and may hold only 5 open vouches. Each fake therefore ties up 150 POA for 30 epochs even if nobody ever challenges it; 500 fakes need 75,000 POA and 1,500 slots, i.e. 300 genuine ivory sponsors. One lock backs one vouch and cannot be reused.
